name: Classic Solitaire Round Diamond Engagement Ring
description: A timeless solitaire engagement ring featuring a stunning round brilliant diamond set in a classic four-prong setting. Available in white gold, yellow gold, rose gold, and platinum. Perfect for the modern proposal.

name: Cushion Cut Halo Diamond Engagement Ring
description: A breathtaking halo engagement ring featuring a cushion cut center diamond surrounded by a shimmering halo of accent diamonds. Available in multiple metals. The perfect choice for maximum sparkle.

name: Princess Cut Solitaire Diamond Ring
description: A modern and elegant princess cut diamond set in a sleek four-prong solitaire setting. The square shape offers a contemporary look with brilliant sparkle that captures light from every angle.

name: Oval Cut Diamond Engagement Ring
description: An elongated oval diamond in a slim pave band creates an elegant, finger-flattering look. This romantic cut maximizes the diamond's brilliance and gives the appearance of a larger stone.

name: Emerald Cut Diamond Ring
description: A sophisticated emerald cut diamond showcases its unique step-cut facets with a hall-of-mirrors effect. Set in a simple bezel or prong setting, this Art Deco-inspired ring exudes timeless elegance.

name: Pear Shaped Diamond Ring
description: A romantic pear shaped diamond — also known as a teardrop cut — combines the elegance of a round and marquise cut. The tapered point is traditionally worn facing toward the fingertip for a slimming effect.

name: Lab Grown Round Diamond Solitaire Ring
description: A brilliant lab grown round diamond set in a classic solitaire setting. Chemically and optically identical to mined diamonds at a fraction of the cost. The ethical, sustainable choice without compromising beauty.

name: Lab Grown Oval Diamond Ring
description: An elongated lab grown oval diamond in a delicate pave band. Lab grown diamonds are graded to the same standards as natural diamonds and offer exceptional value. Perfect for the eco-conscious couple.

name: Classic Men's Wedding Band
description: A sleek, polished men's wedding band crafted in premium metals. A timeless design that pairs beautifully with any engagement ring. Available in multiple widths and metals.

name: Diamond Pavé Women's Wedding Band
description: A delicate women's wedding band set with a continuous row of sparkling pavé diamonds. Designed to stack beautifully with any engagement ring. A perfect symbol of eternal love.

name: Diamond Tennis Necklace
description: A classic diamond tennis necklace featuring a continuous line of brilliant round diamonds set in a flexible four-prong setting. A timeless piece that elevates any outfit, from casual to formal.

name: Diamond Stud Earrings
description: Timeless round brilliant diamond stud earrings set in a classic four-prong setting with secure screw-back closures. A jewelry wardrobe essential that transitions seamlessly from day to evening.

name: Diamond Promise Ring
description: A beautiful promise ring featuring a single sparkling diamond set in a delicate band. A meaningful symbol of commitment, love, and a future together. Perfect for anniversaries and special occasions.
